chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from al-Hakam ibn Miskin, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from al-Mu'alla ibn Khunays and Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'fur, who both said:

We were at a funeral, and near us was a donkey that urinated. Then the wind carried its urine until it struck our faces and our clothes. So we went in to Abu Abdillah عليه السلام and informed him, and he said: 'There is nothing upon you.'

key_terms.جِنَازَةٍ: a funeral procession or funeral gathering
key_terms.لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ شَيْءٌ: there is no liability or obligation upon you

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if wind carries donkey urine onto a person’s face or clothing?
ai.summary: This hadith relates a legal ruling concerning impurity when wind carries spray from a donkey’s urine onto people’s faces and clothes. Imam Abu Abdillah عليه السلام ruled that no obligation fell upon them, indicating the absence of legal consequence in this situation.
